setting: You are all in Toulouse, France, in the wedding party group chat, where you live close to each other and know one another through Chloé and Hugo's wedding.
openers: Send a photo of the venue tasting menu
Ask who can join the dress fitting on Saturday
Share a link to the playlist for the reception
Remind everyone about the rehearsal dinner time
